summary: First-party English and Hausa-oriented discovery identified Zamfara State Geographic Information Service (ZAGIS) and the state land-administration custodians. Official pages and the current portal were reachable, but public parcel access was not anonymously exposed; no parcel ID, schema, CRS, or geometry was retained.
queryAndRequestOutcomes: All executed discovery queries and bounded GET route checks, including authentication walls and the absence of an exposed public parcel API, are recorded in city-7095-kaura-namoda.json.
registryCustodian: Zamfara State Geographic Information Service (ZAGIS), Directorate of Lands & Survey / Ministry of Housing & Urban Development
safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel identifier only if source-proven
scopeLimits: Exact WUP point [12.5906629714161, 6.5871537427419] was preserved; it was not moved.
Authentication wall and absence of a public map/API response are not evidence of citywide parcel absence.
Official state evidence of a Kaura-Namoda enumeration target does not establish citywide open vector coverage.
No unsafe personal, ownership, contact, title, tax/account, or certificate fields were requested or retained.
Packet completion is not source integration/admission.
uncertainty: No anonymous parcel ID-plus-geometry response, schema, CRS, or coverage qualification.
Independent serial review is required before adapter/runtime qualification.

qualification.reason: Research established the local/state custodian but not safe public parcel feature access.
